description: Full logged training-loss history for the 1.45B causal-reference and midpoint-reference pair, seed 42. Loss is loss_metrics/global_avg_loss: training cross-entropy averaged over valid tokens across ranks, in nats/token, not evaluation loss. Step is the training step logged directly as W&B _step. All 7,600 finite observations per arm at steps 1 through 7,600 are retained without smoothing, downsampling, or interpolation; neither arm has duplicate or missing steps.
